result:
Round 178 is planned. The decision is **CONTINUE**, and I changed no app code (the store tree is still clean).

**What I read from round 177:** C passed with real browser checks at both screen sizes and found no bugs. Root published it as `cc984b6`, and the next round starts from that commit. So DUX-R-5b-2b is now done (მზადაა) and the old count-lock finding GATE176-S1 is closed. The regression round isn't due until 2026-10-27, so it doesn't apply today.

**Next task (round 178, DUX-R-5b-3a):** stage 5b-3 was too large for one round, so I split it in two. This round changes only text colours, one token per spot, so they are no longer brass:
- **Where:**
  - DetailPanel (4 lines)
  - StudioWorkspace (exactly 5 lines)
  - Library (1 line)
  - GridMenu check marks (3 lines)
  - Export dialog: the empty-project note, the progress bar and the overload warning (3 lines)
- **Colours:**
  - Labels, counts and warnings become `text-foreground`.
  - The Delete hint and the demo badge become `text-muted`; the badge gets an `outline-strong` border.
  - Hover text becomes `hover:text-foreground`.
  - The progress bar becomes `accent-foreground`.
- **Warnings don't use the `warning` colour:** in the Obsidian theme it is a brass shade (#d9a35b), so it would fail the "no brass" check.
- **Also in this round:**
  - doc 146 is marked Completed (gate-177 suggestion 5).
  - The count of Export dialog brass sites a test treats as kept goes from 6 to 5, because the progress bar is no longer brass (C's note C-R177-G1-562).
  - One test listed the demo badge as "kept" brass by mistake. That test is now in A's file list so A can correct it.
- **A owns:** 12 existing files plus 2 new ones: test file `label-status-colour-ui.test.tsx` (tests DXL1–DXL8) and doc 147. A also runs mutations m278–m287 to show the tests catch regressions. Auth and purchase files stay protected.
- **C checks in the browser:**
  - computed colours, a brass-pixel scan and contrast (text at least 4.5:1)
  - a real blocked lane drag that shows the refusal message
  - the Export dialog states: empty note, progress during a real WAV export, and the overload warning
  - a smoke test that the Grid menu, Library filter and Detail panel still work
  - the usual regression and auth/purchase checks
- **If C can't trigger something:** if the overload or the blocked drag can't be triggered, that check is recorded as not run. 5b-3a then can't be marked done, and I schedule it again.
- **Ableton:** I found no Live source for these colours, so I've marked Ableton parity "not applicable / unverified".

**Rulings and records:**
- I accepted A's two test deviations from round 177.
- From the gate-177 review:
  - Suggestions 1 and 3 (the Delete-with-range border looks like an "on" toggle; the enabled loop brace is louder) are listed for Saba to veto.
  - Suggestions 2 and 4 (Follow paused needs its own screen-reader name; the border-colour transition) go to the deferred Low list, which now has 252 entries.
- I added a note to the existing architecture checkpoint request. The same structural warning has now come up four rounds in a row, with a proposal to pull the toggle styles into one shared place (`studioToggleClass`). I'll send root a fresh, bounded frontend-architect request once DUX-R-5 closes, before M1.

**Round 179:** a regression round if it's planned on or after 2026-10-27, which is expected. After that comes 5b-3b: the Lane drop ring, hint and ghosts, plus the add/import buttons. DUX-R-5 counts as done only after both halves pass C.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice, before writing and at the end. I followed its advice, except that I put the text half first rather than the Lane half, because it closes C's progress-bar note in the same file and needs no drag testing. I didn't consult any project subagents.
